fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of arcana that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and heals you for 30% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Passed Plates
fusions.desc: Releases arcana that deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance per hit to leave them with [Thief of Life] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each of them spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Conjured Banquet
fusions.desc: Restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The amount rises 1% for each 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Sated Mind
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you restore 4 mana. Once every 5 seconds.
